results.title: Dedicated Engineering Teams | Senior Software Developers | QuartzDevs
results.ai_summary: QuartzDevs is a software development agency offering dedicated engineering teams and senior developers. The service covers SaaS, web, mobile, frontend, backend, AI, and Shopify development for startups, enterprises, and agencies. It utilizes technologies like React, Node.js, Python, and Flutter to build cloud-native and cross-platform applications. The company also provides white-label solutions and focuses on security, compliance, and performance optimization.

results.title: Socixis — Your Content. Automated. | AI Marketing Co-Founder
results.ai_summary: Socixis is an AI-powered marketing platform developed by Apixis that automates the creation of brand assets, websites, and content calendars. The service generates logos, website structures, and social media posts for businesses, as demonstrated by a sample build for a burger truck. It targets entrepreneurs and small business owners seeking rapid digital presence setup through automated content generation. The platform positions itself as an AI marketing co-founder that handles branding and growth planning with minimal user input. Currently, the site invites users to join a waitlist, indicating the service may be in a pre-launch or early access phase.

results.title: the360tech — Build. Run. Grow. Automate.
results.ai_summary: the360tech is an independent digital operating team based in Lucknow that provides integrated web development, e-commerce, and marketing services. The company offers solutions for building websites and Shopify stores, running digital operations, growing businesses through search and social media, and automating workflows with AI agents. Its target audience consists of businesses seeking a single accountable partner to consolidate fragmented vendor relationships and reduce agency overhead. The service emphasizes AI-native workflows and positions itself as a lean team of multiple specialists rather than a traditional agency.

results.title: Web Design, Ecommerce & SEO Maidstone, Kent
results.ai_summary: Tuckwood is a digital agency based in Maidstone, Kent, specializing in web design, e-commerce development, and search engine optimization. The service offers a range of digital marketing solutions including pay-per-click advertising, social media management, and local service ads for businesses of various sizes. It targets local enterprises seeking to establish or improve their online presence through responsive websites and measurable advertising campaigns. Notable features include the integration of AI tools like ChatGPT for content and answer engine optimization. The company positions itself as a comprehensive provider covering website creation, ongoing marketing, and technical support.

results.title: Agent Luci — AI that makes room for your business. And your life.
results.ai_summary: Agent Luci is an AI assistant designed for small business owners to manage everyday operational tasks and reduce administrative burden. It offers a dashboard for context gathering, note management, and draft follow-ups, aiming to help users maintain control while delegating routine work. The service targets industries like professional services and construction, with a 'LAAS' (Likely AI as a Service) feature coming soon for client integration.
